title: Carmichael numbers and Erdos 1057 counting bounds

problemStatement.formal: IsCarmichael(n) := n>1 \land \neg Prime(n) \land Squarefree(n) \land \forall p\mid n,\ Prime(p)\to p-1\mid n-1;\ C(x):=|\{n\le x\mid IsCarmichael(n)\}|, with the Erdos 1057 asymptotic question C(x)=x^{1-o(1)} left open.
problemStatement.plain: Backfill the Carmichael-number metadata around the formal Korselt-style definition, verified small examples such as 561 through 8911, elementary structural lemmas, and the open counting conjecture for C(x).
whyMatters: Carmichael numbers are the standard obstruction to naive Fermat primality testing.
The Lean file separates verified finite examples and structural facts from axiom-backed global infinitude results.
The counting conjecture remains open, so the gallery entry should distinguish infrastructure from the unsolved asymptotic target.

proven: `satisfiesKorselt`, `IsCarmichael`, and `C` define the Carmichael-number predicate and counting function.
`carmichael_561`, `carmichael_1105`, `carmichael_1729`, `carmichael_2465`, `carmichael_2821`, `carmichael_6601`, and `carmichael_8911` verify the first sample Carmichael numbers.
open: `erdos1057OpenProblem` records the x^(1-o(1)) counting target; `korselt_backward` and `infinitely_many_carmichaels` are axioms in `Erdos1057Problem.lean`.
knownResults.goal: Present the verified Carmichael examples and structural infrastructure while marking the global counting theorem as open and axiom-backed.

knowledge.progressSummary: PROGRESS: korselt_backward discharged (2 to 1 axioms); Korselt criterion now proved both directions. Remaining axiom is AGP infinitude (deep).
builtItems: korselt_backward proved in proofs/Proofs/Erdos1057Problem.lean:148 (replaces the former axiom); file now has 1 axiom (infinitely_many_carmichaels). PR #24511.
insights: Korselt backward (Fermat implies Korselt) splits cleanly: squarefreeness is elementary (a=p witness); divisibility (p-1)|(n-1) needs cyclicity of the units group (ZMod p)^x.
Squarefree-from-Fermat avoids subtraction-distribution: from p^2 | n derive p^2 | p^n and p^2 | p^n - p, then p^2 | p^n - (p^n - p) = p via Nat.dvd_sub' plus an omega collapse using p <= p^n.

Forcing u^(n-1)=1 for every unit: in field ZMod p, u^n=u and u != 0 give mul_right_cancel0; lift to units via Units.ext + push_cast; a generator's order = p-1 = totient p via ZMod.card_units_eq_totient and Nat.totient_prime, and orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one finishes.
mathlibGaps: infinitely_many_carmichaels (Alford-Granville-Pomerance) remains axiomatized: no Mathlib formalization, deep (>1000 LOC), genuinely blocked.
nextSteps: When Docker/Aristotle return, machine-check PR #24511. Risk points: the simpa [ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.cast_id] closing of hcast; IsCyclic (ZMod p)^x instance resolution; exact name ZMod.card_units_eq_totient.
Only remaining axiom is AGP infinitude (not tractable); the OQ-04 axiom-elimination angle is effectively at its floor.
